title: Violet.Cascade.S01E09.2026.1080p.WEB-DL.H264-DEADVOLUME
description: The small direct-store PAR2 repair corpus with nine interior articles of the second volume deleted from both servers: about 460 slices lost against 400 advertised recovery blocks, so the set cannot be repaired while direct and demotes. The demotion sweep materializes the other volumes from their routed bytes and hands the second back with holes nothing can fill. The job has to settle that volume as damaged and reach the PAR2 verdict — the read-back of a set that is not repairable — instead of resting in Downloading behind a materialization whose owner can never finish. Nine articles keeps the damage under the health threshold, so the verdict is the repair path's and not the health check's.
